c2246.summary: Tyagaraja asks Rama why he must hide his compassion, and imagines Sita, Bharata and Lakshmana putting in a word for him at just the right moment.
m: Must you hide your compassion, O son of Dasharatha?
Seeing that I am looked down upon by the onlookers — (must you still hide it)?
When, full of affection for your beloved, you kiss her, if Janaki says 'this is the moment' and speaks a word for me —
when you melt as Bharata falls at your feet and you shower him with kindness, if Bharata tells you how devoted I am —
when Saumitri praises you skilfully as he serves you with devotion, if he speaks a word for Tyagaraja — (must you still hide your compassion?)
